# .pod quadlets are a podman 5 feature, so this fixture doubles as a check that
# the host really is podman 5 and not a 4.x that merely answers `podman --version`.
# Drives POST /api/pod-action/{server_id}, which builds `podman pod {action} {name}`.
[Unit]
Description=QuadletManager e2e pod

[Pod]
PodName=e2e-test

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
